title: One nuclear warhead on London, and what the three-day guidance assumes

strikes.launch_name: Norwegian Sea, Russian Borei-class submarine (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Hero strike, 08:40 UTC (08:40 London, morning rush). Bulava carrier with published yield estimates of 100 to 150 kt (episode 001 research A3); 100 kt is a simulation choice at the low end, chosen to match the US W76 that the UK Holbrook warhead is derived from (research A13). The UK has never published Holbrook's yield; this is not a claim about it. Airburst for maximum blast and burn area.

strikes.launch_name: Norwegian Sea, Russian Borei-class submarine (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: HM Naval Base Clyde, Faslane and RNAD Coulport
strikes.notes: Home of the four Vanguard-class boats and warhead storage at Coulport, about 3 km west (research A11, A18). Ground burst to hit hardened facilities; this is the strike that carries the local fallout. A boat on patrol (A10, A14) is not in port and is not hit.
